limits: Natural time-stop-assisted coverage is separately marked; it does not establish ordinary moving, unpaused coverage.
A missing event while the source is frozen or while it never reaches its marker is not a missing-event failure.
Destroyed/replaced actors are lifecycle-censored unless independent scene evidence establishes the expected removal.
Source disappearance below a marker only supports a bounded ordinary transition without observed event, not its exact sub-frame cancellation point.
A same-frame hidden event snapshot alone is weaker than a bracketed original manual Update with hidden pre-state and the event inside.
Observer overhead changes frame steps. Event/callback delivery is measured under instrumentation, not a frame-rate-independent timing guarantee.
Callback identity on the same receiver/frame uses group-level listener counts.
Natural found entry requires value>=1; a value-lowered replay cannot establish that the natural pre-event noise threshold gate is reachable.
Positive sound readback means the added field was positive at that observation, not proof that this sound increased it or immediately caused a turn.

data.scope: Read-only original file bytes copied to private memory for disassembly; not game execution.

replay.authority: controlled replay with artificial state, geometry and numeric/visibility preconditions; never natural cancellation evidence

trigger_snapshot.source: original OnPlayerSound SeType2 then original noise OnUpdate

cleanup.limitation: Only the enumerated fields, requested business state, found parameter and player position are checked; this does not establish restoration of the world or interaction side effects.

trials.limitation: A parameter false or business 1->2 alone is not clip cancellation. Receiver replay readback does not prove that a nested native callsite hook executed. Source disappearance below marker with no observed event is a bounded transition observation, not proof of the exact sub-frame cancellation mechanism. Missing snapshots and blend-only crossings remain unknown.
